rounds.response:
Protectable first wave (base bid): a contiguous Riverside Avenue run from Harbor Ln/2nd St through the Waterfront Plaza (≈3 blocks) delivering curb‑inlet raises, regraded low crossings, contiguous high‑visibility crosswalks and curb extensions, modular bioswale/permeable curb inserts, and prefabricated bus boarding islands to produce an immediately visible continuous walking/transit corridor.  
Ordered 0–3 month stop/crosswalk list (south → north): (1) Harbor Ln/2nd St (senior/community hub) — daytime preferred with brief weekend relocations; (2) Elm St — weekend‑focused installs; (3) Waterfront Plaza / commercial core block — weekend/day installs prioritized for visibility; (4) Market St/Pine St — targeted in months 2–3 only if bid allows, otherwise reallocated to Contract B; all installs to use Transit’s low‑disruption windows and include temporary stop relocations as needed.  
Bid alternates / deferrable items to move to Contract B if resurfacing/material costs rise: Market St full‑block treatments, additional inlet upsizing beyond the three in the base wave, permanent concrete bus islands, full‑depth resurfacing and drainage‑main upsizing, and any protected bike‑lane buildouts.  
Communication and scheduling commitments: publish a season‑by‑season Contract B timeline within 30 days of Contract A award (with conditional start triggers: utility clearance and confirmed Transit lane‑closure windows), hold two targeted neighborhood/business briefings, and issue weekly construction alerts for Contract A work.  
Request Procurement: adopt the above first‑wave base scope for Contract A, include the listed bid alternates, and authorize publication of the Contract B timeline and outreach plan upon award.
